metadata.title: Prevalence of 'Feeling Very Happy'
metadata.subtitle: % Very Happy by Year, Age Bucket, and Ideology
metadata.note: Survey-weighted via svy (Taylor-series). Cross-classified by age bucket x ideology. Note: many pre-2004 GSS waves have single-PSU strata that produce inflated standard errors under Taylor variance; point estimates remain valid but SEs/CIs in those years are unreliable and should be interpreted with caution. Custom 3-way breakdown computed via svy v0.17.1; not in the standard GSS pre-computed catalog. Some pre-2004 cells have single-PSU strata, producing degenerate Taylor-series CIs/SEs (clamped or omitted at render time). Point estimates are reliable.

source.name: General Social Survey, United States, 1975-2024; 61949 Observations

metadata.original_question: Taken all together, how would you say things are these days--would you say that you are very happy, pretty happy, or not too happy?

analysis.sample_restriction: non-null happy_binary, age_bucket, ideology, year, weight, vpsu, vstrat; age>=18
